description: Create an X custom audience (a customer list for retargeting or exclusion), optionally filled with people in the same call. Pass ordinary emails, phones (E.164), X handles, X user ids or device ids — they are normalised and SHA-256 hashed on Hermoso's server before X sees them; 64-hex hashes pass as is; anything unusable is named, never sent. X needs up to 48h and about 100 matched people before it can be targeted (add_x_ads_targeting with targetingType CUSTOM_AUDIENCE). Read back. Free.

adAccountId.description: X ad account id (list_x_ads_accounts); omit if only one is shared

twitterIds.description: X user ids to add; hashed on Hermoso's server before X receives them

users.description: one person per entry with several identifiers: {email, phone, handle, twitterId, deviceId}

name: create_x_ads_audience
title: Create an X custom audience
